notes: Scan025 is an upright mathematical manuscript on an otherwise blank sheet. It is text, not a wholly cancelled draft: the many local cancellations do not cross out the whole page.
The dark encircled7 at the head is authorial pagination; the pale24 at lower left is inventoried separately as marginal/archival numbering. Neither is omitted.

The original and each of the two native overlapping halves were observed once. Twenty-one distinct tight crops were made and viewed. p16/p17 tighten unresolved letter/label places; p18 repairs the insufficient raised-right/lowered-tuple scope of p11, while p19-p21 target still-unresolved layers. No decided place was recropped.

lines_read=31 counts the physical non-diagram text/formula lines, including displaced word/tuple and marginal-formula lines. Both complete diagram systems, their labels, the insertion leader, bracket/contour geometry and both handwritten numbers were additionally read and separately inventoried.
Upper right: the X2 set opens with a curly brace and closes with a round parenthesis. The mismatch remains; H normalized it and moved it into the sentence.

First square: the top connector direction remains unresolved because its right end is a rounded return and its left end blunt. The other partial heads/feet are also drawn literally. The label d=((x,y)mapsto(x,y,y)) belongs to the top shaft; no object/arrow direction is supplied from expected cartesianness.

Second square: capital K, the split lower-left equality placement, and both hook tails are preserved. The (=inclusion3= annotation is an above-line insertion with a curved attachment to K2-prime equality; its unmatched parenthesis and final equals sign remain.

Middle calculation: the first cancelled d-sigma start has no separately visible closing parenthesis. The final live inclusion3 argument has no comma between x and y. These are separate literal omissions, retained despite the regular earlier coordinate pairs.

The sigma(point-prime) annotation is a flat bracket with upturned ends; it is represented with rules around normal mathematical text rather than a curly underbrace. Its point-double-prime label is retained.

The lower condition begins with the literal abbreviation Il f et s. The letters et are independent of the large f, and only s has a final stop. No expansion to faut appears in the transcription. The short du/de-like word before the doubtful parenthesized diagram label is also preserved.

The OK contour is open and irregular, extends towards the right page edge, and contains the cancelled donc at lower left. The words are normal text, with only the bordering stroke drawn. The d’où point-prime=e2 note sits above the contour.

The cancelled Mais line remains unresolved. A separately lowered, subsequently crossed tuple-like insertion is preserved under a whole-tuple doubt. The p-rho versus p-rho-squared alternatives are left open; the superscripts are not reconstructed from a projection identity.

The clearer upper l’on est ramené à insertion is distinguished from the doubtful cancelled baseline. Two separate small cancelled fragments occur near the later prouvons que/si run and are inventoried individually. The live si versus2° reading remains open.

At lower right the written second case is i=1, as is the final implication. H gives i=2 in the second case. The literal i=1 is retained; the local logical consequence check is recorded separately and does not decide which place the author intended to change.
The final Qed/qed has no separate terminal full stop. Its initial-letter case is kept open. The long end stroke is a return of the final d, not a separately established underline.

H expressly omits cancelled trials in an editorial synopsis. This does not make the missing ink source text dispensable, and the synopsis is not a local H doubt mark. Its note about the crossed rho exponents already records their deletion state; that state alone is not counted as a correction. H end-of-packet Structures stratifiées heading and following note are editorial/transition material and are excluded without treating them as manuscript words.

Only this page packet, the common instructions, its notation snapshot, and this page images/work were read. No OCR, external research, other page/report inspection, TeX compilation, upload or aggregate-file edit occurred.
